title: Default theme
summary: Required theme plugin. Colour is CSS variables. Structure overrides go through pluginFront.ui replace. This package currently restyles tokens, not Button markup.

blocks.title: Tokens, not a second CSS file
blocks.text: Kernel theme.css uses light-dark(). Configure hexes write store.theme.tokens via PATCH /admin/store. ThemeTokens applies bootstrap.theme.tokens only when the merchant saved hexes. An empty map leaves CSS in charge.

items.description: Admin → Plugins → Default theme → Configure. Swatches: surfaces, ink, accent.
Theme tokens are not Preferences fields.
Cannot be disabled. Only one theme should be enabled.

blocks.text: back/register.ts appends storefront.theme.slots: header, burger, bottomBar, footer. That name is outside CORE_OPENING_FILTERS but the kernel still applyFilters it.

blocks.title: This theme does not replace Button today
blocks.text: pluginFront.ui with replace: true is the structure path. Theme kind wins over a generic replace. Colour stays CSS variables; replace a component when markup must change.

blocks.caption: If you add a structural override

blocks.text: See Kernel UI registry for precedence, the full KERNEL_UI name list, and names that are not wrapped.
